messages:
Hana G: Hi everyone, I accepted the new-hire block on my calendar but the invite time shows 09:00 PT while my client converted it to local and hid the join link. Can someone confirm UTC and paste the meeting link + passcode? Also where will the recording/transcript live?

Marta (People Ops): Welcome Hana! :wave: Core orientation is Tue 09:00 PT = 16:00 UTC. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9012345678 (passcode: rwd-onboard). Recording + transcript will be uploaded to Drive under /company/onboarding/ in a dated subfolder within 24h.

Onboarding Bot: Note: Orientation events are authored in Pacific Time by default. Recording + autogenerated transcript will be posted to the Drive folder and linked back to this thread.

Hana G: Thanks! Could we get a small timezone table in the event body for future invites (PT / UTC / a couple common zones)? It would help international hires avoid confusion.

Ben (Calendar Ops): Good suggestion  well update the invite template to include PT + UTC + ET/CET/AEST examples and a Drive placeholder for the recording. Also a reminder: open the event from the shared "Redwood Onboarding" calendar (not the mailer) if you see duplicates  some clients merge invites and hide details.

Ruth L: Quick accessibility note: please flag if you need captions or a plaintext transcript early. We can surface the transcript link in-thread as soon as its available.

Hana G: One last thing  if I cant make the live session because of local time, will the Drive doc include a timestamped agenda or chapters? Skipping to sections would be super helpful.

Marta (People Ops): Yes, well add a timestamped agenda doc to the Drive folder and request chapter markers from the recording team. If chapters arent available, the agenda will have minute marks.

Onboarding Bot: Reminder set: "Upload orientation recording + transcript to Drive" scheduled for +24h after event; post link to this thread.

Hana G: Awesome, thanks everyone  Ill accept and watch the recording if needed.
